name: APT41 (G0096) vs our Black Basta chain (Week 10)
description: APT41 techniques (MITRE ATT&CK G0016... G0096 and campaigns C0017, C0040). Red = APT41 technique also used in the Black Basta chain we studied in Weeks 4-9 (our detections already cover these). Gold = APT41 signature technique not in our chain. Blue = other APT41 technique.
